Hi Ben / Lauren,

Thanks — can confirm the following from BrightStage / ON24 side: 

- RTMP ingest: rtmp://ingest.on24.com:1935/live (use stream key: BRIGHT-RTMP-2026-06-30). Full list of endpoints in attached file.
- Audio: ON24 recommends 48 kHz, 16-bit, stereo accepted. If you send mono at 48k we will upmix.
- Zoom -> ON24 relay: we will accept a single RTMP push from your Zoom webinar host machine.
- Recording consent: ON24 can include a required registration checkbox labeled: "I consent to being recorded and used for on-demand viewing and marketing materials." Zoom's native consent popup is optional but helpful for speakers.
- Passcode gating: we can configure an ON24 passcode for the studio (recommended if the recording is restricted). Zoom passcode for guests is supported — provide us the passcode string and we'll set the studio to require it.

Test slot: we have availability tomorrow (Tue Jun 30) at 3:00 PM PT for a 20-minute end-to-end run. Please confirm and we'll spin up a test event (both ON24 and Zoom test links attached).

Attachment: rtmp_endpoints.txt (text)

Best,
Maya Singh

All — thanks for the test run today. Quick summary and action items: 

- Outcome: end-to-end stream successful to ON24. ON24 ingest accepted stereo @ 48 kHz.
- Sync: observed ~150 ms lip-sync offset at the viewer side (visual leads audio by ~150 ms) on the ON24 player. Local Zoom recording aligned with host monitor; will attach sample timing log.
- Registration: marketing approves the shorter checkbox: "I consent to being recorded and contacted about Redwood Inference products." Legal will follow up if they request the longer phrase.
- Passcode: RWD-2026 worked for both Zoom and ON24 studio.
- Recommendations: add a 150 ms audio delay in the ON24 player settings or align encoder buffer with host output. Ops to test encoder delay setting during next rehearsal.

Attachments: recording_sample_log.txt (text)

Next steps:
- Lauren: apply the opt-in checkbox copy to the registration landing page (by EOD Wed).
- David: file a Jira ticket for the audio delay tuning with sample log attached (JIRA-OPS-1248).
- Maya: please confirm final retention settings for the on-demand file (we prefer 18 months).

Thanks everyone — feeling good for tomorrow's live.

Ben
